Dear Gregory, Patterson and Fischer Accounts Team,

Thank you for your invoice 12222347 dated 2017-03-18 for a total of 136.13 USD.

We are unable to match this invoice to an open purchase order because no PO number appears on it. Could you please reply with the applicable purchase order number, or confirm if no PO applies?

Additionally, please confirm the invoice date and currency. If you are able, a corrected or reissued copy of the invoice showing these details clearly would be helpful.

Thank you for your assistance. We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable
